Recognizing Early Signs of Addiction

Addiction often develops gradually, and the early signs can be easy to overlook. Changes in mood, social withdrawal, secrecy, declining performance, and growing dependency may indicate that someone is struggling.

Recognizing these warning signs early can help families start important conversations and seek support before the situation becomes more serious.

When living with someone struggling with alcohol addiction, it's easy to become focused on catching lies, checking stories, and searching for proof. But this often keeps you stuck in the cycle instead of moving toward healing.

Recovery begins when the focus shifts from controlling another person's behaviour to understanding addiction, setting healthy boundaries, and seeking the right support.

Center is well equipped with all required latest equipment's and entire team of Doctors and other staff of the Center are very much committed sincere, professional and caring. I am grateful to all of them and in particular to Physiotherapist Dr.Poorvi Madam, Dr.Amrita Madam and Dr. Shravani Madam and also to Sister Rashida and Mr. Sandipji .They all made  sessions very comfortable  in friendly environment.
Initial assessment is very much detailed and tailored- made program is drawn for everyone considering their conditions and requirements. Oxygen concentrator facility is also provided at the center for those who require the same. After every 12 sessions also detailed reassessment is done and your performance is compared with the last assessment. While attending the sessions  you also get benefitted by Basic Yoga session taken  by Yoga Teacher Mrs. Vaishali  Madam and diet consultation provided by Dietitian Ms.Mehvish Madam.
At center you are monitored conscientiously during your exercise session and all readings whether it is your SpO2 ,pulse rate or Blood Pressure and also distance covered by you on treadmill or scientific bicycles are  taken and  systematically recorded  for assessing your improvements. Group Class conducted at center for limb exercises are very much enjoyable.
One unique thing about this center is considering social responsibility every month lectures by renowned specialist Doctors in various faculties is arranged at the center for everyone and all your medical related questions are addressed to your satisfaction and some test like Bone density are also conducted free of charge.
I would highly recommend anyone with any lung related issue to take benefit of this Center.
I take this opportunity to sincerely thanks Dr.Pralhad Prabhudesai Sir and Mrs.Vaishali Prabhudesai Madam for providing such an excellent state of art Pulmonary Rehabilitation Center in Goregaon and wish PPPRC all the Best.

Satish Narkar

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text: Hi. My mother was diagnosed with pulmonary fibrosis and had reduced lung capacity due to the same. Her pulmonologist suggested pulmonary rehab and we visited a few centres before finalizing Pratibha Prabhakar Rehab centre as we found it to be efficiently managed. My mother's case was handled by Dr. Purvi and upon explaining the issues she tailored the workouts/exercises and laid out a detailed plan for the recovery. Dr Purvi appeared to be very meticulous and sincere and has expertise on the subject. After a month’s course at Pratibha Pulmonary Rehab center under Dr. Purvi's guidance we have seen a vast improvement in my mother’s health. Thanks to the entire team for the excellent treatment plan, care and guidance and I would surely highly recommend Dr.Purvi and the centre for pulmonary rehabilitation.

featured_reviews.name: Subir Chatterjee
featured_reviews.review_text: I had enrolled for a program with Pratibha Prabhakar Pulmonary Rehab post Covid as per my physician's advice. The initial  assessment was extremely detailed and the exercises during my visits were under supervision and were carefully calibrated towards a gradual recovery plan. The staff and therapists were extremely caring and professional in their conduct. I have completely recovered from the post covid breathing issues after these sessions and would recommend a visit to this center to anyone having breathing issues.
